main_figures.title: LoD verification planning pipeline
main_figures.caption: LoD verification planning pipeline (main text). Laboratories lock a detection claim—G1 verify LoD, G2 compare lots/reagents at c*, or G4 qualitative k/n (S0)—classify hit-rate/binary data (S1), plan replicates from operating characteristics (S5), confirm with exact Fisher/Boschloo methods (S6), and emit an auditable report (S7). G3 LoQ and the optional continuous EP17 LoB branch (S2–S4, P17) are out of main-text scope; see Supplement Fig S-LoB and Table 2. Certificates P1, P7, P8, P18.

main_figures.title: Folklore triple failure
main_figures.caption: Three independent failure modes of folklore small-n practice. Panel A (G1): probability p^n of observing n/n hits; one-sided Clopper–Pearson lower bound after 20/20 remains far below 0.95. Panel B (G2): exact Fisher miss probability β at folklore n=20 for illustrative reagent pairs; required n* annotated. Panel C (P16): SE(log10 LoD95) under interior-level design versus saturation plateau (non-identifiable concentration LoD).

main_figures.title: Finite-sample theory: gap, Berry–Esseen, Pareto
main_figures.caption: Panel A: asymptotic versus exact Fisher power versus n (90% vs 80%) with 80% reference. Panel B: exact Fisher power heatmap over (p_A, p_B) at folklore n=20 (red–green scale); ring marks 90% vs 80% cell. Panel C: Type I versus power Pareto plane (P18); dashed arrow from folklore to powered design.

main_figures.title: Remedies: powered n*, exact power, design
main_figures.caption: Panel A: required n per arm (80% power) versus competitor hit rate with reference p_A=90%; folklore n=20 marked. Panel B: exact Fisher power at folklore n=20 versus powered n* for 90% vs 80% (G2 reference). Panel C: asymptotic SE(log10 LoD95) for folklore equal-log spacing, c-optimal grid, and minimax dense-near-LoD design (P13). LoB sample-split (P17) panel: supplement FigS_lob_p17_split.

main_figures.title: Tier-A empirical anchor (LoD replicate planning)
main_figures.caption: Four-panel Tier-A LoD anchor (Table 7). A: qPCR hit rate versus standard concentration (detection curve). B: guidance n versus folklore n=20 on LoD-focused tier-A deposits. C: public deposit size versus planned n for LoD claims. D: headline replicate counts for G1, G2, and G4 versus folklore n=20. Radioimmuno LoQ profile moved to supplement (FigL_radioimmuno_loq_profile).

supplement_figures.title: P17 LoB sample-split (continuous EP17 path)
supplement_figures.caption: Supplement only — not part of main-text LoD scope. Under skewed blanks, unsplit gated parametric LoB inflates exceedance above nominal α; P17 half-split with Bonferroni α/2 restores nominal Type I. Relevant when laboratories use continuous EP17 LoB paths (S2–S4).

supplement_figures.title: LoQ precision profile (tier C troponin demo)
supplement_figures.caption: CV% versus pool mean for EP17 Example 3 troponin pools (evidence tier C). Engine-consistency demo only; not a primary empirical claim.

supplement_figures.title: Discrimination power versus n by Δp
supplement_figures.caption: Asymptotic two-proportion power for p_A=0.90 versus p_B=p_A−Δ, α=0.05 (two-sided). Folklore n=20 (vertical reference) is severely underpowered for Δ=0.10.

supplement_figures.title: Miss probability β at folklore and powered n
supplement_figures.caption: Type II error for selected reagent pairs including 90% vs 80% and 90% vs 50%. Full curves; main-text summary in Fig 2B.

supplement_figures.title: All-positive trap (standalone)
supplement_figures.caption: Left: P(X=n)=p^n; right: CP lower bounds versus Uniform residual risk after n/n. Expanded version of Fig 2A.

supplement_figures.title: Continuous n*(p_A,p_B) surface
supplement_figures.caption: Equal-arm Fleiss–Chow sample size for 80% power over (p_A,p_B). Three-panel continuous discrimination study; main-text slice in Fig 4A.

supplement_figures.title: Concentration relative to LoD_95
supplement_figures.caption: Operating characteristics as a continuous function of r=c/LoD_95 (below / at / above LoD): verification pass probability and comparative miss β.

supplement_figures.title: Evidence landscape
supplement_figures.caption: Public multi-assay deposits (tier A–C) and audited simulation stress DGPs (tier S). See Evidence Ladder (Table 5).

supplement_figures.title: Folklore n=20 versus algorithm-required n
supplement_figures.caption: Bar comparison of powered n* and achieved power at folklore n=20 across illustrative scenarios; complements Fig 2B.

supplement_figures.title: Multi-level LoD design SE comparison (full)
supplement_figures.caption: Asymptotic SE(log10 LoD95) for equal log-spacing folklore, c-optimal grid, and minimax dense-near-LoD design at planning slope; worst-case SE over slope ratios β ∈ [0.5, 1.5]β_plan (P13). Main-text summary in Fig 4C.

tables.title: Primary LoD estimands G1, G2, G4
tables.caption: Detection-limit estimands before sample-size planning. Mixing goals in one episode is forbidden; engines differ by row. G3 (LoQ / precision) is an optional EP17 branch documented in Supplement Table 2 and excluded from main-text claims.

tables.title: LoQ / precision design (G3)
tables.caption: Required n so that CV of the mean (100·(σ/μ)/√n) meets target CV%, and n for mean CI half-width under Normal sampling. **Supplement only (G3 LoQ)** — out of main-text LoD scope; radioimmuno tier-A profile in FigL; troponin EP17 pools tier-C demo (Fig S1).

tables.title: Asymptotic versus exact discrimination power
tables.caption: For selected (p_A,p_B,n): asymptotic pooled-z power, exact Fisher power, exact pooled-z enumeration, Monte Carlo pooled-z, and miss β under Fisher. Primary small-n confirmatory reporting should prefer exact / Boschloo; asymptotic surfaces remain design approximations. Supports Fig 3.

tables.title: Machine certificates P1–P18
tables.caption: Internal review table: proposition ID, statement, pass/fail, key numeric details (P1–P8 core lemmas and bounds; P12–P18 identification, c-optimal/minimax design, selective LoB inflation, folklore inadmissibility). Re-run produces SHA-auditable certificates in the analysis protocol.

tables.title: Public evidence ladder
tables.caption: Downloaded real datasets by evidence tier (A=raw/replicate-level public deposits; B=summary; C=synthetic EP17 demo; S=simulation DGPs) and assay family. Includes radioimmuno precision/linearity (Zenodo 12664367), RMN ID50 (Zenodo 17108929), Carobene multi-lab chemistry, and CPTAC/MSstatsLOBD proteomics blank–LoB as tier-A cases. Hematology analyzer blank–LoD raw deposits remain a gap.

tables.title: Finite-sample Type I error under H0
tables.caption: Empirical Type I rates for pooled-z and Fisher (and Boschloo at n=20) under p_A=p_B=p. Documents conservatism of Fisher and calibration of pooled-z.

tables.title: Tier-A meta-summary across public deposits
tables.caption: One row per evidence-tier-A dataset: parametric gate outcome, model path, guidance n versus folklore n=20, and LoQ@CV20% when a precision profile applies. Tier C/S deposits are excluded by design. Supports Fig 5.

tables.title: G1 Wilson vs Clopper–Pearson coverage
tables.caption: Monte Carlo coverage and mean width for Wilson and Clopper–Pearson intervals under binomial LoD hit-rate scenarios. Supports confirmatory G1 interval policy.
